'''''Kashyk''''' <small>[sic]</small> '''''Welcomes You''''' was, seemingly, both a travel advertisement for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and a beverage known as [[Kashyk (beverage)/Legends|Kashyk]]; put up on the planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ad was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]<ref name="Catch" /> and came in several different [[Color/Legends|color]] palettes: One version of the ad was put up as a giant [[Painting/Legends|poster]] at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], a location in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. However, it was mirror-inverted and became faded with [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> A complete and non-mirrored copy of this version also appeared on a large electronic billboard higher up in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="Pursuit">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> A large, differently colored version of the ad appeared as a poster in a different part of Coruscant's underworld,<ref name="Catch" /> while a smaller one with the same color palette was put up near [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress']] dwelling, although half the poster was eventually torn off.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
